The ELK Helm chart configures PVCs with `storageClassName: advanced`, but `:resource.helm_release.elk` has no ordering dependency on the Kubernetes StorageClass. Ensure the class exists before Helm creates the claims to avoid transient pending claims or Helm readiness timeouts.

----------------------------------------

----------------------------------------

The chart configures persistent volumes with storageClassName `advanced`, provided by :resource.kubernetes_storage_class.advanced. The Helm release should wait for that StorageClass to exist before creating its PVCs.

----------------------------------------

[merged-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-atleast2of3]
[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
helm_release.elk configures Elasticsearch PVCs with `storageClassName: advanced` as a literal string, so Terraform has no ordering edge to kubernetes_storage_class.advanced. The Helm release can be applied before the storage class exists, leaving the PVCs Pending and the release timing out.

----------------------------------------

----------------------------------------

No attribute reference or depends_on expresses this ordering.

On a fresh apply the helm release can be installed before the secret exists, causing Elasticsearch pods to fail with CreateContainerConfigError. Add an explicit depends_on for this secret.
